item.title: Nation Starting To Wonder If People Who Spend Life Singing Songs To Toddlers On YouTube Might Not Be All There Mentally
item.description: U.S. — Amid social and political tensions reaching new highs with violent clashes between government law enforcement and protesters, the nation revealed it had started to wonder if people who spend their lives singing songs to toddlers on YouTube might not be all there mentally.

item.title: Time To Move To A Red State? Know The Signs
item.description: Things in America are getting pretty dicey these days. So dicey, in fact, that people in blue states are starting to wonder if it's time to evacuate to the safety of more politically conservative places. Knowing when to get out of Dodge is vital.

item.title: Tragedy As Entire Studio Audience Drowns In Flood Of Jimmy Kimmel's Tears
item.description: LOS ANGELES, CA — Emergency crews responded to a catastrophic incident at the famous El Capitan Theater in Hollywood last night, where an entire studio audience tragically drowned in a flood of Jimmy Kimmel's tears.

item.title: Too Cold To Start Civil War Right Now, Nation Agrees
item.description: U.S. — The bitterly divided nation has finally agreed on one thing: it is just way too cold to start a civil war right now.

item.title: Want To Resist ICE? Here Are 12 Things You Can Do Today
item.description: Is Trump's Gestapo getting on your nerves? Looking for ways to show support for undocumented Americans by standing up to federal law enforcement? You're not alone. Rest assured, there are things you can do to show you're part of the resistance.

item.title: Man Ready To Take On The World After Sliding Favorite Pocket Knife Into Jeans Pocket
item.description: BOISE, ID — Though events taking place around him threatened to envelop him in uncertainty and stress, a local man reported that he was ready to take on the world after sliding his favorite pocket knife into his jeans pocket.
